answer: Graph-based trust propagation curtails Sybil attacks by routing random walks from verified seed nodes across peer networks. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of acquiring genuine endorsements from honest nodes to cross bottleneck cuts. Serving as an algorithmic lantern, the network lets reputation advance as slowly as a glacier, revealing instant identity fabrication as a fable. However, this structure penalizes honest newcomer agents with severe cold-start friction.
